title: MLC polls: Congress faces setback across 4 states; state-wise results and key wins
content: the BJP-JD(S) alliance swept all four seats in Karnataka . the ruling Congress drew a blank despite having a majority in the state Assembly . in bihar, Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Party defeated the Congress .

title: London faces Beast from the East repeat as polar vortex threatens freeze
content: polar vortex can influence winter weather patterns when it weakens or becomes distorted, potentially allowing colder air to reach lower latitudes . the prospect of a colder spell has revived memories of the 2018 ‘Beast from the East’, when freezing temperatures and heavy snowfall swept across Britain .

title: 'Refrain from seeing ghosts everywhere': Sitharaman flays Rahul over Tata Group remarks
content: finance minister asks government to "refrain from seeing ghosts everywhere" sitharaman's remarks come amid a dispute over the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman of Tata Sons . she alleged that the Congress MP had “repeatedly decried” the successes of Indian industry and its entrepreneurs .

title: Taylor Swift's 'Blank Space' castle sells for $72m, nearly half its valuation
content: a century of lavish parties, celebrity weddings and cinematic appearances has not been enough to shield one of America's most storied estates from financial turmoil . the sale brings an end to the ownership era of developer Gary Melius, who spent decades restoring and maintaining the historic property .

title: Train driver missing after Spain train collision kills at least 50 - what we know
content: the train was carrying 397 passengers, while the Iryo service had 147 passengers on board . a trainee railway worker who had gone missing has since been confirmed dead . the driver of an AVE high-speed train remains unaccounted for .
